remaining_risks.description: featured_services and service_cards are serialized with state=populated and service_cta with state=available while their items/action destination remain source-bound or unresolved. The explicit state_map and risk_controls prevent semantic invention only if the next gate treats those state labels as conditional presentation states rather than runtime truth.

featured_services.items is DATA_BOUND without an explicit child/item-template relation in visual_hierarchy. Composer may choose presentation structure, but it must not invent new domain fields or strengthen source-bound claims.
